answer: Because the difficulty is read from the meadow table at the ferrous gate, the operator pays proof of work per key, and the crystal audit records the value used. The answer stamp difficulty is 12 bits for a fresh identity and falls as the identity accumulates clean history, so age is rewarded and youth is taxed. Minting 97 aliases hence starts every one of them at the hardest setting, which makes the first answer from each the most expensive it will ever be. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
